purpose: Determine whether each canonical stock satisfies all prerequisite research, live-regime, edge-activation, portfolio-ranking, and candidate-quality conditions required to enter a later trade-engineering stage. This gate is readiness classification only and does not authorize or execute a trade.

inputs.stage6_regimes: Stage 6 PSY29 Live Regime Engine V2 output
inputs.stage7_activation: Stage 7 PSY29 Research-Conditioned Edge Activation output
inputs.stage8_ranking: Stage 8 PSY29 Portfolio Edge Ranking output
inputs.stage9_quality: Stage 9 PSY29 Candidate Quality Confidence output

conditions: Canonical symbol has exactly one verified Stage 5 profile.
Research evidence is treated as behavioural prior, not current-session probability.
Stage 6 regime is valid and not DATA_STALE or DATA_INVALID.
Stage 7 reason_code and match_reason are present and consistent.
Stage 8 portfolio_rank is a positive integer within active-candidate coverage.
Stage 8 ranking_score is finite and within 0-1.
Stage 8 provenance points to the verified Stage 5 profile source.
Stage 9 candidate_quality_score is finite and within 0-100.
Stage 9 quality score is explicitly not a probability.

decision_rule: TRADE_READY only when every required gate is PASS. Any failed prerequisite yields NOT_READY. DATA_STALE or DATA_INVALID from live data is preserved as the terminal state. Missing, malformed, or contradictory prerequisite data fails closed as DATA_INVALID.

output_rules.NOT_READY: Live data is valid/fresh but one or more prerequisite gates fail.
output_rules.DATA_INVALID: Live data or cross-stage contract/provenance is invalid, missing, contradictory, or cannot be verified.

fail_closed_rules: Exactly 29 canonical symbols must be present.
All five stage inputs must cover exactly the canonical 29.
Any missing or duplicate symbol is DATA_INVALID for the run.
Cross-stage symbol, regime, activation, provenance, or trade-flag contradictions fail closed.
No TRADE_READY row may exist unless every required gate is PASS.
No non-active row receives a trade-ready state.
DATA_STALE and DATA_INVALID must never be converted into TRADE_READY.
Readiness is not authorization and must not produce an execution instruction.

provenance.regime: Stage 6 PSY29 Live Regime Engine V2
